easy.def: A big room for sports and exercise.
examples: We play in the gym.
The gym is big.
Gym class is fun.

more.def: A large room or building with equipment for sports and exercise.
examples: We play basketball in the gym.
My mom goes to the gym after work.
The school gym has a rope to climb.

easy.def: A big room for sports and exercise.
examples: We play ball in the gymnasium.
The gymnasium is big and loud.
Our class ran in the gymnasium.

more.def: A large room or building with equipment for sports and exercise.
examples: The school gymnasium has a basketball court and climbing ropes.
The concert was held in the gymnasium because it was raining.
Students stretched on mats in the gymnasium before the race.

easy.def: A person who does flips and balances in sports.
examples: The gymnast did a flip.
A gymnast is strong.
She is a gymnast.

more.def: A person who performs exercises that need strength and balance, such as on a beam or bars.
examples: The gymnast flipped across the mat.
A gymnast balanced on the beam.
She trains every day to be a gymnast.

easy.def: A sport with flips, jumps and balance.
examples: I take gymnastics.
Gymnastics is hard.
She does gymnastics.

more.def: A sport in which people do exercises, such as flips, jumps and balancing, on mats and equipment.
examples: I take gymnastics after school and have learned to do a cartwheel.
Gymnastics needs strength, balance and practice.
She won a medal in gymnastics.
